option.name: SCRIPT_TEXT
option.value: ID=$(flutter devices --machine | python3 -c "import json,sys;print(next((d['id'] for d in json.load(sys.stdin) if d.get('targetPlatform','').startswith('android') and not d.get('emulator')),''))"); [ -n "$ID" ] || { echo 'no physical Android device connected'; exit 1; }; flutter drive --driver=test_driver/perf_driver.dart --target=integration_test/one_shot_latency_test.dart --profile -d "$ID" --dart-define=ITERATIONS=3 --dart-define=OUTPUT="$PWD/../results-local/current/one_shot_latency_android.json" --dart-define=GIT_SHA="$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" --dart-define=PKG_VERSION="$(grep -m1 '^version:' ../../pubspec.yaml | cut -d' ' -f2)"
